description: Mutate the app's React Query cache: invalidate / refetch / reset / remove a single query (by queryHash, from get_react_query), or clear the entire query cache. Use this to fix stale data, force a refetch, or reset state during debugging.

action.description: invalidate/refetch/reset/remove one query (by queryHash or queryKey); clear empties the whole cache; list shows the queries.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

queryHash.description: The target query's hash (from get_react_query, shown in backticks).

queryKey.description: Or the query key, e.g. ["offers"]. Acts on every query whose key starts with it.

name: react_query_action
